title: Hali za Masharti (Theme 5: Mitazamo hasi ya kijinsia)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 9 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child uses -nge- in both halves for an unlikely condition now and -ngali- for a past one that did not happen.
steps: Is the condition possible now, unlikely, or past?
contexts: negative gender attitudes: Kama wasichana wangalipewa nafasi...

board.say: Ni jambo la kweli au la kufikirika la zamani?

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child writes "Angalikuja mapema, angalipata basi."

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Hali ya masharti ya -nge- huonyesha nini?" Kwa nini "ukweli uliotimia" si jibu sahihi?
Soma tena: "Ni sentensi ipi ina -nge-?" Kwa nini "Angalijua angalikuja." si jibu sahihi?
Soma tena: "Ni sentensi ipi ina -ngali-?" Kwa nini "Angejua angekuja." si jibu sahihi?
Sehemu ya pili inaonyesha jambo la kweli au la kufikirika?
misconceptions.repair: Masharti ya kufikirika huchukua -nge- pande zote: ningekuwa, ningejenga.
